name: manual_b19ea4
claim: In a PR security-scan log, N new findings counts findings absent from the baseline and can be large on main too; before attributing a failure, read the same job on main and reproduce the scan locally with the same baseline. Here 167 of 168 new findings existed on main, which passed, and one error-level finding in the PR's own file caused the failure.

decisions.notes: Orama PR 491 failed the agent-surface scan; main printed the same new-findings count and passed; the local diff against main was exactly one finding.

rationale: Orama PR 491 failed the agent-surface scan; main printed the same new-findings count and passed; the local diff against main was exactly one finding.
